title: Self-Assembling Peptide Hydrogels for Mucosal Drug Delivery: Synthesis, Triggering Strategies, and Therapeutic Applications.
authors: Zheng, Xin; Jin, Susu; Zhu, Shuyao; Lee, Tao; Jin, Zhaohui
one_liner_zh: 综述自组装肽水凝胶用于黏膜药物递送，虽涉及肽序列设计但核心是药物递送应用，未聚焦蛋白质结构计算建模，仅提及AI辅助设计作为展望，与本课题关系较弱。
abstract: Self-assembling peptide hydrogels (SAPHs) have emerged as promising platforms for mucosal drug delivery due to their excellent biocompatibility, programmable sequence design, and diverse triggering strategies. This review systematically discusses the molecular basis, synthesis techniques, and triggering strategies of SAPHs, highlighting how these elements collectively enable in situ gelation and on-demand drug release at mucosal sites. We also review applications across the oral, gastrointestinal, ocular, vaginal, middle ear, and respiratory mucosa, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of SAPHs in infection treatment, tissue repair, and immunomodulation. We further compare SAPHs with other mucosal delivery systems and summarize the clinical status of mucosal delivery products; although several products are in clinical use, no SAPH-based product has been approved for mucosal delivery, and the factors limiting clinical translation are discussed. Despite significant progress, several challenges remain, including balancing mechanical stability with degradation, ensuring batch-to-batch consistency, confirming long-term biosafety, and obtaining regulatory approval. With the integration of artificial intelligence-assisted design and modular programmable platforms, SAPHs hold considerable promise for precision mucosal drug delivery.
abstract_zh: 自组装肽水凝胶（SAPHs）因其优异的生物相容性、可编程的序列设计以及多样化的触发策略，已成为黏膜药物递送的有前景平台。本综述系统讨论了SAPHs的分子基础、合成技术和触发策略，重点阐述了这些要素如何共同实现黏膜部位的原位凝胶化和按需药物释放。我们还综述了其在口腔、胃肠道、眼部、阴道、中耳及呼吸道黏膜中的应用，展示了SAPHs在感染治疗、组织修复和免疫调节中的治疗潜力。我们进一步将SAPHs与其他黏膜递送系统进行比较，并总结了黏膜递送产品的临床现状；尽管已有若干产品在临床使用，但尚无基于SAPH的产品获批用于黏膜递送，并讨论了限制临床转化的因素。尽管取得了显著进展，仍存在若干挑战，包括平衡机械稳定性与降解性、确保批次间一致性、确认长期生物安全性以及获得监管批准。随着人工智能辅助设计和模块化可编程平台的整合，SAPHs在精准黏膜药物递送方面具有相当大的前景。
